boundary: Real application with unchanged CSP. Parent frame-src only Cloudflare rejects the entire static data document. DOM/CSP audit URL fields are redacted; native frame unreachableUrl and exact owner/src association identify the rejected ad documents. Error documents are not supplier creative rendering. Request interception is a safety guard, not CSP proof. Main-frame path events can duplicate notifications and are not user action counts.

evidence.title: direct / never creates ad contexts or requests
evidence.observationBoundary: Request interception is a safety guard; opaque frame network events may be incomplete. Parent and child CSP rejection, document addresses and frame resource telemetry are recorded separately. The unchanged app CSP rejects the static data document before supplier execution. A blank browser error document is not a rendered advertisement. Resource entries establish observed URLs, not transfer success or absence. No live creative behavior is established.
